caption: The drawing depicts a detailed illustration of a single spur, placed horizontally near the center of a cream or off-white background. The spur is primarily colored in shades of silver, gray, and black. The main body of the spur features intricate engraved or etched designs, highlighted with lighter silver tones, and includes a swirling pattern. The neck of the spur curves outward to the left and ends in a large rowel, which is circular with evenly spaced, pointed black spikes radiating outward. The spur strap and buckle are rendered in a darker tone, resembling either black or dark brown, with visible metal fixture details. The background is plain and minimally textured, with the artist’s name “HARRY MANN WAIDSELL” written in small, neat, uppercase letters to the right of the spur. There are some faint brownish marks and lines, possibly indicative of age, visible around the edges of the paper.
title: Spur
